app.name: Reality Check
app.tagline: Check it before you share it

home.greeting: Namaste. You are in a safe place.
home.title: What would you like to do today?
home.subtitle: Check a message you are unsure about, learn the warning signs, or practise on a pretend phone. Nothing here can harm you.

check.title: Check something suspicious
check.body: Paste a message, link or photo. The community looks at the evidence with you.

learn.title: Learn to spot scams
learn.body: Short, friendly lessons about fake messages, UPI and AI videos.

practice.title: Practise on a safe phone
practice.body: Try real-looking situations on a pretend phone. No real money, no real risk.

home.continue: Pick up where you left off
home.nothingYet: Nothing started yet. When you begin a lesson or a practice, it will appear here.

promise.title: Our promise to you
promise.p1: We never ask for passwords, PINs or OTPs.
promise.p2: Practice pages use pretend banks and apps.
promise.p3: Investigations here are demonstrations, clearly labelled.

welcome.title: Welcome to Reality Check
welcome.body: Pick a text size that feels comfortable. You can change it any time.
welcome.preview: This is how text will look. Can you read it easily?

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetBody: This clears your saved posts, comments, practice and lessons on this device.
